newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-DUTCH INTERNATIONAL DE GOEY SIGNS FOR CHELSEA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DUTCH INTERNATIONAL DE GOEY SIGNS FOR CHELSEA.

text.p: Dutch international goalkeeper Ed de Goey has signed for English premier league Chelsea, the club managed by his fellow countryman Ruud Gullit, the Dutch ANP news agency said on Wednesday.
De Goey, 30, has played for Dutch premier league club Feyenoord Rotterdam since July 1990.
He has 29 international caps and played last week in a 2-0 friendly victory over South Africa.
